split.calibration: none; too few independent shapes for calibrated uncertainty

retrospective_warning: The historical summary was already visible before this split; fitting is frozen before new training/replays, but these are not blinded or prospectively untouched test outcomes.
features: N, D, sum and maximum of row term counts among the first 64 input rows; all available before reduction; prefix is scanned even if the final fitted rule is constant.
labels_and_loss: Minimize exact integer proxy sparse_entries_visited_by_xor + (pivot_read_bytes+pivot_write_bytes)/8 over the two legal policies. Preserve components because one word of I/O and one sparse term visit are conventional equal weights, not machine instruction equivalents.
model: Exhaustive empirical-risk minimization over two constants and one-level decision stumps on the four input features, split at adjacent training values. Tie: fewer branches, then first encountered. With one label class this returns an explicitly constant predictor.
training_charge: Both archived training-policy reductions charged by the proxy, plus trace/input bytes and parsed scalar/term counts and candidate-evaluation counts separately; no free label oracle. Dense RREF, hashing, parsing, decompression, filesystem and trace writing are not fully instruction-priced, so this is a total of counted proxy components, not complete computational cost.
evaluation: Fresh n5/n9 both-policy dense-RREF controls and n15 both-policy replay. Heldout n17 remains archival evaluation unless spare budget permits replay. Choose each heldout policy from input features/model only before reading heldout outcomes. Compare selected policy with both fixed policies; include prefix/model overhead and one-time training separately. No post-outcome model revision.
boundaries: Restricted whole-pass selector for one fixed D=4 Macaulay row pass. No general learned F4, closure, solving-degree, GPU, distribution, end-to-end ECDLP, speedup or external-fastest claim. Large row spaces retain independent correctness gap; same rank/hash/replay is not independent certification.
controls: Fresh exact mutual dense RREF on n5/n9 both policies, archived/fresh deterministic counter comparison on n15, negative/null result retained, frozen source/input/binary digests. Shared host L0 diagnostic only.
